---
title: "Pilot Owner Management — PO-01"
labels: ["feature", "pilot-owner", "priority/2"]
assignees: []
---

As a Pilot Owner, I want to assign teammates and set milestones so I can manage execution.

Acceptance criteria:
- Team invite and assignment UI (add/remove teammates).
- Milestone CRUD with due dates and status.
- Notifications to teammates on assignment and milestone changes.
